prompt: Implement the Template Method pattern: extend the provided abstract Report class in SalesReport by implementing body() and overriding header(), while the final build() method fixes the overall algorithm.
explanation: The Template Method pattern puts the unchangeable outline of an algorithm in a final method of an abstract base class, delegating individual steps to overridable methods. Abstract steps like body() force every subclass to supply them, while hook methods like header() and footer() have defaults a subclass may optionally override. build() being final guarantees no subclass can rearrange the skeleton.
hints: SalesReport only needs two small methods -- build() is inherited and must not (and cannot) be redefined.
Implement String body() to return "sales"; the abstract keyword in Report forces you to.
Add String header() returning "SALES" with the same package-private signature; skip footer() so the inherited "F" is used.
